scope: fixed V2 VAL, 12 unseen subjects; subject-equal aggregation

metrics.absolute: observed points to exact predicted triangle surface in camera coordinates
metrics.translation_aligned: same geometry after oracle XYZ translation; diagnostic only

interpretation: Txyz changes placement only, so its aligned metric is analytically identical to Official.
The selected S checkpoint improves both absolute and aligned error versus Official, supporting some improvement beyond global translation on V2 VAL.
Its aligned metric is 0.195 mm worse than Historical V1 E1, so it does not establish superior non-translation geometry over that historical comparator.
Arm-best means are descriptive model-selection summaries and are not SEALED estimates.

new_v2_sealed.interpretation: Mean absolute and aligned metrics improve, but only 6/12 subjects improve in absolute error and only 4/12 improve aligned error versus Official. The mean result does not establish broad per-subject robustness.
